up: Return the exact activity values and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649954. For each matching activity record, provide the standard relation, standard value, standard units, and the canonical SMILES of the compound.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649954'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
